behaviour: When GitHub accepts a new merge queue entry and the automatic priority step then fails, for example on a refused ledger hierarchy read, the merge queue command still prints the queue outcome with the error in a separate priority_error field and exits zero; a refused enqueue still fails and never runs the priority step.
seam: scripts.swarm.merge_queue.operate queue action with a priority callable, and scripts.swarm.cli.main on swarm merge queue
